doc: Stands in for saves/battle_re/loc070_imps_roly_pre_lake.state, its own provenance on the playthrough: Truce Canyon (loc 070) reloaded by the ROM's own loader (--teleport 112 12 18 1, method jmp, 200 frames) after the canyon's fights, where Crono has learned Cyclone (the playthrough's leg 14 ends in Guardia Forest with $2837 bit 7), its group of two Blue Imps and a Roly respawned; then Down 60 frames toward them, as the capture's drive.
